# CMM Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness

**DeepSeek Harness can observe and operate authorized macOS applications in the
background while you
keep the focus and the cursor.**

Most computer-use integrations work by taking over: they activate the app,
move the pointer, and typ

e into whatever is in front. That makes the machine
unusable while an agent works, and it makes ever

y action ambiguous — you can
never tell whether a click came from you or from the model.

This plugin takes the other route. It talks to a small, signed macOS helper
that reads one authorize

d window through the Accessibility API and
ScreenCaptureKit, and acts on that window's elements dire

ctly. Nothing is
brought to the front, nothing is posted to the pointer, and no global keystroke
is

brought to the front, nothing is posted to the pointer, and no global keystroke
is ever synthesised.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## What is different
| Property | What it means in practice |
| **Background computer use** | Actions target a specific window, not "whatever is frontmost". You k

eep working in another app. |
| **No cursor hijacking** | The adapter never posts pointer events. In

`background` mode it does not even advertise a click or drag tool. |
| **No focus stealing** | No `
activate`, no `focus`, no window raising. The helper's ledger records what the environment did versu

s what the action did. |
| **Live PiP mirror** | A floating panel shows the authorized window as the

agent works. A frozen stream is labelled as paused, never presented as live. |
| **Window-scoped ca
pture** | Capture is bound to one window id, so a tab change does not silently retarget the mirror.

|
| **Semantic Accessibility actions** | `press` and `set_value` on resolved elements, not pixel coo

rdinates. |
| **Attachment provenance** | A capture only reaches the model with the identity of the

window it came from, its pid and its snapshot generation. |
| **Fail-closed authorization** | Zero a
pps are authorized until you write an allowlist. A missing, unreadable or malformed policy means "no
access", never "allow everything". |
## Requirements

- macOS 15 (Sequoia) or later, Apple silicon.
- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3 (the only version this r

elease was tested
against — see docs/compatibility.md).
- Xcode Command Line Tools (`xcode-select --

install`) for `python3`, or any
Python 3.9+ reachable as `python3`.
- Screen Recording and Accessibi

lity grants for **CMM Computer Use** — macOS
asks once, in System Settings.
## Install
Three steps. None of them touches your Harness profile by hand.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then open a conversation in Harness and ask it to look at an app you have
authorized. The first tool

call is refused until you write the allowlist —
that is the designed first run, not a failure.

Full instructions, including the from-tarball and from-checkout paths, are in
docs/installation.md.
## Permissions, in one paragraph

The helper needs **Screen Recording** (Screen & System Audio Recording) to
capture the window it is

told to capture, and **Accessibility** to read and act
on that window's elements. Both are granted t

o the app, by you, in System
Settings; the plugin cannot grant them and does not try. Neither grant

is
scoped by macOS to a single application — which is exactly why the helper
carries its own per-app

allowlist on top. Revoking either grant stops all work
immediately. Details, including how to autho

rize and revoke individual apps,
are in docs/permissions.md.
## Security model

- **Deny by default.** No allowlist, no access. The helper starts with zero
authorized applications.

- **Separate scopes.** `observe` (read the tree, capture the window) does not
imply `control` (pres

s, set value).
- **A local socket, not a port.** The helper serves a Unix socket in a `0700`
directo

ry. There is no TCP listener, no HTTP endpoint and no FIFO.
- **No ambient elevation.** The plugin d

oes not write `launchctl setenv`, does
not install a global allowlist and does not modify your profi

le.
- **Bounded results.** Captures are capped in size, observations are bounded in
element count, a

nd the projection refuses a frame whose attachment does not
match its declared media type and dimens

e projection refuses a frame whose attachment does not
match its declared media type and dimensions.

The threat model, the exact bounds and what is deliberately *not* protected are
in SECURITY.md.
## Privacy

The plugin collects nothing and sends nothing anywhere. There is no telemetry,
no analytics and no u

pdate check. Captures stay on the machine and are handed
to the model you configured in Harness. See

ures stay on the machine and are handed
to the model you configured in Harness. See docs/privacy.md.
## Troubleshooting

The two failures people actually hit — "no authorized applications" and
"permission not verified" —

and their fixes are in
docs/troubleshooting.md.
## Uninstall

Then revoke the two grants in System Settings. The plugin never removes them
for you; macOS only let

grants in System Settings. The plugin never removes them
for you; macOS only lets a person do that.
## Compatibility
| Component | Tested |

| DeepSeek Harness | 0.2.1-rc.3 |
| macOS | 26.7.1 (Tahoe) on Apple silicon |
| Python (adapter) | 3

.9 (system `/usr/bin/python3`) |
| Node (Host/Client) | the runtime shipped inside Harness |

A version that is not in this table is not supported, whatever it does. See
docs/compatibility.md fo
r what "tested" covered.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Architecture, module map and the reason for each layer:
docs/architecture.md. The wire protocol is a

separate,
versioned contract: docs/computer-bridge-protocol.md.
